description: Listed building consent for installation of an Air Source Heat Pump in the side area at the rear of the property, rebuilding the rear outrigger walls due to defective structure, changing the approved Crittall style double glazed windows and doors to the conservatory and rear bay to timber framed double glazed windows and doors in hardwood to match the style of the existing fenestration and building external pipes
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Location Plan, A691-PL21, A691-PL25-B, A691-PM07, A691-PM08, A691-PM09-A, A691/F01-C and Heritage, Design and Access Statement. Received: 21/11/2023
Photograph Sheets. Received: 11/12/2023
A691/P33, Plant Noise Assessment 1967-AF-00001-03. Received: 10/4/2024
A691-PL07-C, A691-PL08-D and A691-PL09-E. Received: 26/4/2024
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
